# `audit.yaml` reference

Every key `audit.yaml` accepts, from the pydantic models in `legacy_audit/config.py` (class `AuditConfig`). Unknown keys are rejected. Relative paths are resolved against the folder holding `audit.yaml`; `/` and `\` both work as separators. The starter file written by `legacy-audit init` is `legacy_audit/templates/audit.yaml`, and `audit.example.yaml` at the repository root shows every section with comments.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `application` | `Application` | required |  |
| `application.name` | `str` | required |  |
| `application.description` | `str \| None` | `null` |  |
| `application.owner` | `str \| None` | `null` |  |
| `source` | `Source` | (section) |  |
| `include` | `list[str]` | `["**"]` |  |
| `exclude` | `list[str]` | `[]` |  |
| `components` | `list[ComponentSpec]` | `[]` |  |
| `inputs_dir` | `str` | `"audit-inputs"` |  |
| `output_dir` | `str` | `"audit-output"` |  |
| `overrides_file` | `str` | `"audit-overrides.yaml"` |  |
| `target` | `Target` | (section) |  |
| `target.profile` | `Literal['spring-boot-angular', 'wildfly-gke', 'none']` | `"spring-boot-angular"` | spring-boot-angular (default), wildfly-gke (lift onto WildFly on GKE, database to PostgreSQL) or none (audit only, nothing suggested) |
| `target.java` | `str` | `"25"` |  |
| `target.spring_boot` | `str` | `"4.1"` |  |
| `target.angular` | `str` | `"21"` |  |
| `target.wildfly` | `str` | `"41"` |  |
| `target.jakarta_ee` | `str` | `"11"` |  |
| `target.database` | `str` | `"postgresql"` |  |
| `target.cloud` | `str` | `"gcp"` |  |
| `counting` | `dict[str, str]` | `{"batch_job": "One schedulable job (Autosys job, JCL job, cron entr...` |  |
| `complexity` | `ComplexityConfig` | (section) |  |
| `complexity.weights` | `dict[str, float]` | `{"cyclomatic": 2.0, "fan_out": 1.0, "fields": 0.2, "integrations": ...` | Score = sum of weight x (feature / scale); missing keys keep defaults |
| `complexity.scale` | `dict[str, float]` | `{"cyclomatic": 10.0, "loc": 100.0}` | Divisor per feature before weighting (default 1) |
| `complexity.thresholds` | `dict[str, float]` | `{"complex": 25.0, "medium": 10.0, "very_complex": 50.0}` | Lowest score of each band above Simple |
| `complexity.high_unit` | `int` | `20` | Cyclomatic complexity from which a function is reported as too complex |

| `rules.enabled` | `list[str]` | `["risk", "postgresql", "dependency"]` | Rule packs to apply: risk, postgresql, dependency |
| `rules.disabled` | `list[str]` | `[]` | Rule ids to switch off |
| `rules.severity` | `dict[str, str]` | `{}` | Rule id -> severity (info/low/medium/high/critical) |
| `rules.packs_dir` | `str \| None` | `null` | Folder with team rule packs; a rule with the same id replaces ours |
| `branding` | `Branding` | (section) |  |
| `branding.theme` | `str` | `"neutral"` |  |
| `branding.logo` | `str \| None` | `null` |  |
| `branding.primary_color` | `str` | `"#1f4e79"` |  |
| `branding.accent_color` | `str` | `"#2e75b6"` |  |
| `branding.font` | `str` | `"Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif"` |  |
| `branding.pptx_template` | `str \| None` | `null` | PowerPoint template: a name from templates/ (blue, orange, purple), a file name or a .potx path relative to audit.yaml; None means the first template found |

| `pdf.enabled` | `bool` | `true` | Write PDF copies of the reports when a browser is found |
| `pdf.browser_path` | `str \| None` | `null` | Edge, Chrome or Chromium program; found automatically when empty |
| `pdf.paper` | `Literal['A4', 'Letter']` | `"A4"` |  |
| `pdf.max_table_rows` | `int` | `500` | Rows printed per table; the full lists stay in the HTML and CSV |
| `pdf.detail_pages` | `bool` | `true` | Add each component and flow page to the technical/functional PDFs |
| `pdf.timeout_seconds` | `int` | `180` | Per page printed |
| `inventory` | `InventoryConfig` | (section) |  |
| `inventory.include_binaries` | `bool` | `false` | Inventory images, objects and executables too. Archives (jar/war/ear/zip) are always inventoried because library detection needs them. |
| `inventory.max_file_size_mb` | `float` | `20.0` | Larger files are inventoried (hash, size) but not read for LOC |
| `inventory.use_default_excludes` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `inventory.skip_build_output` | `bool` | `true` | Leave out compiler and IDE output: bin/, classes/, obj/, Debug/, Release/ folders holding compiled files and no source or script, Eclipse output folders (.classpath), and files a precompiler generated next to their source (foo.c beside foo.pc, foo.cob beside foo.pco, Foo.java beside Foo.sqlj). Each is reported. |
| `inventory.component_grouping` | `Literal['auto', 'module']` | `"auto"` | auto: a Maven/Gradle library module goes into the deployable (war, ear, runnable or batch jar) that uses it, the folders beside the modules are one component, and without a build file part folders of one technology are one component (COBOL + BMS, JCL + PROCLIB, the batches of a batch folder). module: one component per module and folder (decision 176) |
| `inventory.workers` | `int` | `0` | Processes used to analyse files and grade SQL; 0 = one per CPU less one (at most 8), 1 = no extra processes |
| `integrations` | `IntegrationsConfig` | (section) |  |
| `integrations.group_by_service` | `bool` | `true` | One row per external service: all the endpoints called on one host (REST, SOAP, HTTP), the queues and channels of one queue manager, the files of one server or folder; false keeps one row per address (decision 177) |
| `sql` | `SqlConfig` | (section) |  |
| `sql.dialect` | `str` | `"oracle"` | Dialect of SQL found in code: oracle, db2, sqlserver, sybase, mysql, postgresql, generic. Embedded SQL in COBOL uses cobol.sql_dialect. |
| `cobol` | `CobolConfig` | (section) |  |
| `cobol.copybook_paths` | `list[str]` | `[]` | Folders (relative to the source root) searched first for COPY members |
| `cobol.sql_dialect` | `str` | `"db2"` |  |
| `metrics` | `MetricsConfig` | (section) |  |
| `metrics.duplication_tokens` | `int` | `50` | Tokens in a duplicated window (smaller finds more clones) |
| `effort` | `EffortConfig` | (section) |  |
| `effort.enabled` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `effort.weights` | `dict[str, dict[str, list[float]]]` | `{"batch_job": {"complex": [4, 6, 9], "medium": [2, 3, 5], "simple":...` | Person-days [low, likely, high] per item and level; merged with defaults |
| `security` | `SecurityConfig` | (section) |  |
| `security.dependency_check` | `DependencyCheckConfig` | (section) |  |
| `security.dependency_check.enabled` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `security.dependency_check.path` | `str \| None` | `null` | dependency-check script; found on PATH when empty |
| `security.dependency_check.data_dir` | `str \| None` | `null` | Local NVD database folder (--data) |
| `security.dependency_check.nvd_mirror_url` | `str \| None` | `null` | Team NVD mirror, used when syncing |
| `security.dependency_check.offline` | `bool` | `true` | Never update the database during a scan |
| `security.dependency_check.timeout_minutes` | `int` | `30` |  |
| `security.osv_scanner` | `OsvScannerConfig` | (section) |  |
| `security.osv_scanner.enabled` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `security.osv_scanner.path` | `str \| None` | `null` | osv-scanner binary; found on PATH when empty |
| `security.osv_scanner.data_dir` | `str \| None` | `null` | Local OSV database folder |
| `security.osv_scanner.offline` | `bool` | `false` | false: ask osv.dev during the scan; true: local database only |
| `security.osv_scanner.timeout_minutes` | `int` | `15` |  |
| `security.jdk_tools` | `JdkToolsConfig` | (section) |  |
| `security.jdk_tools.enabled` | `bool` | `false` | Run jdeps/jdeprscan on jars (slow; opt-in) |
| `security.jdk_tools.java_home` | `str \| None` | `null` | JDK holding jdeps/jdeprscan; else PATH |
| `ai` | `AiConfig` | (section) |  |
| `ai.provider` | `AiProvider` | `"copilot"` | copilot (VS Code chat, model picked there), openai (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), anthropic, azure-openai or ollama (local) |
| `ai.model` | `str \| None` | `null` | Model name, or the deployment name for azure-openai |
| `ai.base_url` | `str \| None` | `null` | Endpoint; default per provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama on localhost) |
| `ai.api_key_env` | `str \| None` | `null` | Name of the environment variable holding the API key (never the key); default OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY |
| `ai.api_version` | `str` | `"2024-10-21"` | azure-openai API version |
| `ai.temperature` | `float \| None` | `0.1` | null leaves the model's default |
| `ai.max_output_tokens` | `int` | `16000` |  |
| `ai.json_mode` | `bool` | `true` | Ask the endpoint for JSON output when it can |
| `ai.context_chars` | `int` | `150000` | Facts and source sent per stage (characters, about 4 per token) |
| `ai.timeout_seconds` | `int` | `600` |  |
| `ai.repair_rounds` | `int` | `2` | Retries with the validator's errors |
| `ai.ca_bundle` | `str \| None` | `null` | Corporate CA certificates file (PEM) |
| `ai.copilot_model` | `str \| None` | `null` | Model the Copilot agent asks for (agent file `model:`), e.g. 'Claude Sonnet 4.5 (copilot)'; empty = whatever is picked in the chat |

## `source` variants

`source` is either a local source (the default) or a Git source, chosen by `type`.

### `LocalSource`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `Literal['local']` | `"local"` |  |
| `paths` | `list[str]` | `["."]` |  |

### `GitSource`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `Literal['git']` | required |  |
| `repos` | `list[GitRepo]` | required |  |
| `cache_dir` | `str \| None` | `null` | Clone cache; default ~/.legacy-audit/cache |

### `GitRepo`

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `str` | required |  |
| `ref` | `str \| None` | `null` | Branch, tag or commit; default branch if empty |
| `paths` | `list[str]` | `[]` | Sub-paths to scan |
| `name` | `str \| None` | `null` |  |
| `token_env` | `str \| None` | `null` | Name of the environment variable holding a read-only token |
